comment: The one place that says where a repository keeps its three layers (positioning, infoarch, design), the approval ledger and the judgment record. scripts/layer_paths.py and scripts/layer_paths.mjs read this file and nothing else in the skills' code spells these paths (a test counts the literals). Every value is a path relative to the repository root. foreign_roots are directories that mean the repository follows a different layout than this version of the skills reads: finding one stops every command (LAYER_LAYOUT_FOREIGN_ROOT) instead of reading around it. hint is appended to that message (the migration command, once a layout has one).
